instruction: Scan in/src/main.py, in/src/util.py and in/src/web/routes.py for uppercase markers 'TODO: text', 'FIXME: text', 'TODO(owner): text' or 'FIXME(owner): text'. Write out/todos.json: a JSON array, ordered by file path then line number, of {"file": path relative to in/, "line": 1-based line, "kind": "TODO"|"FIXME", "owner": owner or "", "text": text after ': '}.
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
